Name: Innate Undead
Description: You are Undead and have Apoptosis. When adjacent to a body, your basic attack is Feast.

Name: Apoptosis
Description: At the start of each battle, gain Loose Chunks equal to half your [img:con] rounded down. When you eat poisoned food, heal 4 HP and gain +1 [img:str], +1 [img:con], and +1 Loose Chunk instead of its normal effects.
Notes: Innate Passive. Loose Chunk: Gain -1 [img:str], -1 [img:con], and spawn poisoned food the next {stacks} times you take damage.
